Name: Farmhouse Basement Mod - Content Patcher
Author: Squall4120
Description:
This mod introduces new [b]Basement[/b] and [b]Bathroom[/b] renovations to the Renovation menu at the Carpenter's Shop.
[list]
[*][b]Basement Renovation:[/b] The Basement occupies the same space as the Southern Room and the Cubby. The Basement option will not show up if either the Cubby or the Southern Room is currently added to the farmhouse.
[*][b]Bathroom Renovation:[/b] The Bathroom shares the space with the Corner Room. The Bathroom option will not show up if the Corner Room is currently added to the farmhouse.
[/list][b]
[/b]The [b]Bathroom[/b] includes the following features:[list]
[*]A [b]bathtub[/b] for recovering energy (like the Spa).
[*]A [b]radio[/b] to play music.
[*]A [b]mirror[/b] to change your character's appearance.
[*]A [b]toilet[/b] you can flush for immersion.
[*]Customizable [b]walls [/b]and [b]flooring[/b].
[/list]
This is a remake of MiniPantsu's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/524]Farmhouse Basement Mod[/url], as their version is no longer compatible with the current version of Stardew Valley.

[b]What's Different:[/b][list]
[*]The Basement and Bathroom are implemented as [b]additional Renovations[/b] instead of replacement maps or overlays for the Farmhouse.
[*]The Bathroom layout has been redesigned and differs from MiniPantsu's original version.
[/list]
I will [b]not [/b]be including a version with the bathroom in the cellar location.

Bathroom textures were created by [b]Prismuth[/b] for their [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1626]Compact Bathroom Mod[/url].

Translations: English, French, Chinese, Russian

Translations welcome!
